selection: One fixed condition; checkpoint selection uses validation only.
test_policy: one final selected-serving test per declared child; never select using test
aggregation_policy: single ten-choice window, one forward, no tournament or null choices

balance.method: retain every unique case; classes already balanced

purpose: Retrain combined v4 data and descriptions with fixed best settings on grouped stratified five folds; exploratory synthetic data.

tracking_notes.parameters: Pinned best validation-selected settings from prior seed confirmation. No Hyperopt search in this retraining.
tracking_notes.validation_display: Condition metrics summarize selected serving heads across five folds. Fold time series retain per-epoch validation; selected head metrics are in details/report.json.
tracking_notes.comparison: 640 train/160 validation per fold, 64/16 per tool. Scenario and contrast-pair groups never cross train/validation. Original validation20 unused. Test20 excluded from selection; repeated test estimates remain exploratory.
tracking_notes.baseline: All folds initialize from pinned base, not a previous trained head.
tracking_notes.limitation: Data and descriptions change together; this run does not isolate their individual effects. Old train600 CV scores are not a paired comparison with new train800 folds.

reference_runs.selected_by: highest mean validation accuracy; test excluded

cv.pool: v4 train800 only; all 800 cases validated exactly once
cv.stratify: actual tool ID, not permuted alias
